{"id":1600832840,"question_id":3656,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1744131113,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1600832840/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Number of Operations to Make Elements in Array Distinct","memory":"27.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumOperations(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        unordered_set<int>st;\n        int dup_index = -1;\n\n        for(int i=n-1 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            if(st.count(nums[i]))\n            {\n                dup_index = i;\n                break;\n            }\n            st.insert(nums[i]);\n        }\n        \n        if(dup_index == -1) return 0;\n\n        int to_remove = dup_index + 1;\n\n        return (to_remove + 2)/3;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-number-of-operations-to-make-elements-in-array-distinct","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":545}
